title: An integrated framework for adaptive land use optimization through multidimensional evaluation and geospatial simulation: A case study of Lingbao City, China
title_zh: 基于多维评价与地理空间模拟的自适应土地利用优化集成框架——以中国灵宝市为例
title_primary: 基于多维评价与地理空间模拟的自适应土地利用优化集成框架——以中国灵宝市为例
title_secondary: An integrated framework for adaptive land use optimization through multidimensional evaluation and geospatial simulation: A case study of Lingbao City, China
authors: Yue Chen, Fangxin Chen, Cong Ou, Yurui Li
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Land use optimization plays pivotal roles in bridging regional sustainable development with national strategic priorities, yet persistent methodological disconnects between diagnostic evaluation and prescriptive optimization hinder practical implementation. Addressing this critical gap, this research develops an integrated “Evaluation-Diagnosis-Simulation-Optimization” (EDSO) framework through synergistic coupling of multi-dimensional functional indices, PLUS modeling, and random forest. The framework utilizes multi-source geospatial data with Lingbao City, Henan Province, China, as the case study area. The results indicate that the transition marked by 1.40% farmland loss due to forest regeneration and urban-rural construction expansion, while non-agricultural output value surged by 23.09% alongside improved infrastructure accessibility (2012–2020). Rural depopulation paralleled the degradation of commercial and public services, exposing vulnerabilities in rural governance. The simulation demonstrates the comprehensive optimized scenario's superiority in landscape efficiency, with 280 million CNY higher ecological value than alternatives. The optimized schedule identified 200.22 km² of land returned to forest and 4.32 km² of fragmented rural low-efficiency built-up land. The schedule identified forest carbon sink peaking at 35-year tree growth cycles, critical insights informing 30m-resolution rotation scheme. The EDSO framework's ability to integrate diagnostic analytics with spatially adaptive interventions offers a transformative toolkit for territorial planning, effectively bridging the science-policy gap.
abstract_zh: 土地利用优化在连接区域可持续发展与国家战略优先事项中发挥着关键作用，然而诊断评估与规范优化之间长期存在的方法论脱节阻碍了实际应用。针对这一关键缺口，本研究通过多维功能指标、PLUS模型与随机森林的协同耦合，构建了集成的“评估-诊断-模拟-优化”（EDSO）框架。该框架利用多源地理空间数据，以中国河南省灵宝市为案例研究区域。结果表明，2012—2020年间，以1.40%耕地因森林恢复和城乡建设用地扩张而流失为特征的转型过程中，非农产值增长了23.09%，基础设施可达性同步改善。农村人口流失与商业和公共服务退化并行，暴露了乡村治理中的脆弱性。模拟结果表明，综合优化情景在景观效率方面具有优越性，其生态价值比替代情景高出2.8亿元。优化方案识别出200.22 km²土地需退耕还林，以及4.32 km²碎片化的农村低效建设用地。该方案识别出森林碳汇在35年树木生长周期达到峰值，为30米分辨率的轮作方案提供了关键见解。EDSO框架将诊断分析与空间适应性干预相结合的能力，为国土空间规划提供了一套变革性工具，有效弥合了科学与政策之间的鸿沟。

title: Macroprudential policy and the role of institutional investors in housing markets
title_zh: 宏观审慎政策与机构投资者在住房市场中的作用
title_primary: 宏观审慎政策与机构投资者在住房市场中的作用
title_secondary: Macroprudential policy and the role of institutional investors in housing markets
authors: Manuel A. Muñoz, Frank Smets
official: 官方在线 2022-07-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Since the onset of the Global Financial Crisis, the presence of institutional investors in housing markets has steadily increased over time. Real estate funds (REIFs) and other housing investment firms leverage large-scale buy-to-rent real estate investments that enable them to set prices in rental markets. A significant fraction of this funding is being provided in the form of non-bank lending - which is not subject to regulatory LTV ratios - and REIFs are generally not constrained by leverage limits. We develop a quantitative DSGE model that incorporates the main features of the REIF industry and identify leakages of existing macroprudential policy: (i) already existing countercyclical LTV rules on residential mortgages trigger a credit reallocation towards the REIF sector that can amplify financial and business cycles; while (ii) "non-existent" countercyclical LTV rules on lending to REIFs are particularly effective in taming such cycles. Due to the different mechanisms through which they operate, both types of LTV rules complement each other and jointly yield larger welfare gains (for savers and borrowers) than in isolation.

title: Sovereign Debt, Default Risk, and the Liquidity of Government Bonds
title_zh: 主权债务、违约风险与政府债券流动性
title_primary: 主权债务、违约风险与政府债券流动性
title_secondary: Sovereign Debt, Default Risk, and the Liquidity of Government Bonds
authors: Chaumont, Gaston
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Macroeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Secondary markets for sovereign bonds are illiquid because of trad- ing frictions. I build a framework with endogenous illiquidity to study its implications on credit spreads and default risk. The model integrates directed search in secondary markets into a sovereign de- fault model. With trading frictions, secondary market demand and supply flows are important drivers of bond prices, while they are irrelevant in standard sovereign default models. I find that small trading frictions can significantly tighten a government's financial constraint and that policy interventions that reduce the sell flows in the secondary markets can partially revert the effect of trading frictions.

title: Existence and nature of CvdN equilibrium
title_zh: CvdN均衡的存在性与性质
title_primary: CvdN均衡的存在性与性质
title_secondary: Existence and nature of CvdN equilibrium
authors: Nathan W. Chan, Anne van den Nouweland
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-19 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: CvdN equilibrium extends ratio equilibrium to local public good economies. A key and unique feature of CvdN equilibrium is that jurisdictions are fully endogenized, where the equilibrating factor is agents’ agreement on public good levels and the sharing of public good production costs. We show equilibrium existence and sorting behavior for a large class of public good economies. We furthermore elucidate how key aspects of the economy influence the nature of CvdN equilibrium, including the role of consumption preferences, jurisdictional preferences, and properties of the public good production function. These factors make possible different equilibrium jurisdiction structures, including the grand coalition, only singletons, or intermediate-sized jurisdictions, as well as jurisdictions with homogeneous or heterogeneous membership. Usefully, because it fully endogenizes jurisdiction formation, CvdN equilibrium offers a unified approach to economies with local public goods and those with global public goods, and it facilitates investigation into the underlying factors of an economy that lead to public goods being provided locally or globally. Our model can provide microfoundations for multiple concepts from the literature, including homophily, segregation, sorting, and small-group effectiveness.
abstract_zh: CvdN均衡将比例均衡扩展至地方公共品经济。CvdN均衡的一个关键且独特之处在于，辖区完全内生化，其均衡因素在于代理人对公共品水平及公共品生产成本分摊的共识。我们证明了在广泛类别的公共品经济中均衡的存在性与分群行为。此外，我们阐明了经济的关键方面如何影响CvdN均衡的性质，包括消费偏好、辖区偏好以及公共品生产函数特性的作用。这些因素使得不同的均衡辖区结构成为可能，包括大联盟、仅单个成员、或中等规模辖区，以及同质或异质成员构成的辖区。有用的是，由于完全内生化辖区形成，CvdN均衡为地方公共品经济与全球公共品经济提供了统一的分析框架，并有助于探究导致公共品在地方或全球层面供给的经济深层因素。我们的模型可为文献中的多个概念提供微观基础，包括同质性偏好、隔离、分群及小群体有效性。

title: Cash or care? Insights from the German long-term care system
title_zh: 现金还是照护？来自德国长期照护体系的启示
title_primary: 现金还是照护？来自德国长期照护体系的启示
title_secondary: Cash or care? Insights from the German long-term care system
authors: Kesternich, Iris, Romahn, Andre, Van Biesebroeck, Johannes, Van Damme, Marjolein
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: The German universal long-term care (LTC) insurance program offers beneficiaries the choice between in-kind services and a cash benefit, which can be used for anything, including informal care. The optimal level of the cash benefit depends on substitution between formal and informal care options, the cost of public funds, and distributional considerations. To evaluate various policy options, we estimate a random-coefficients demand model for the period 1999-2015 using data on the universe of LTC patients supplemented with micro moments from the German Mikrozensus. Results show strong heterogeneity in patient preferences for the three different LTC options: informal, ambulatory and stationary care. A counterfactual analysis predicts that abolishing the cash subsidy leads to a decline in patient surplus that far outweighs the savings in public expenditure. It suggests that many countries could benefit from the introduction of a cash subsidy option for LTC.
abstract_zh: 德国普遍性长期护理（LTC）保险计划为受益人提供了两种选择：实物服务或现金补贴，后者可用于任何用途，包括非正式护理。现金补贴的最优水平取决于正式与非正式护理选项之间的替代关系、公共资金的成本以及分配考量。为评估各种政策选项，我们利用1999-2015年间覆盖所有长期护理患者的数据，并结合德国微观人口普查的微观矩，估计了一个随机系数需求模型。结果显示，患者对三种不同的长期护理选项——非正式护理、门诊护理和住院护理——存在显著的偏好异质性。反事实分析预测，取消现金补贴将导致患者剩余下降，其幅度远超公共支出的节省。这表明，许多国家可能从引入长期护理现金补贴选项中受益。

title: Fertility incentives in Canada: Period and cohort perspectives
title_zh: 加拿大生育激励措施：时期与队列视角
title_primary: 加拿大生育激励措施：时期与队列视角
title_secondary: Fertility incentives in Canada: Period and cohort perspectives
authors: Siha Lee, Sitian Liu
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study the fertility effects of the 1997 Quebec Family Policy using two complementary approaches: (i) a period‐based repeated cross‐sectional analysis that examines the impact on period fertility (i.e., fertility rates in a given calendar year, such as births per 1,000 women age 15 to 49), and (ii) a cohort‐based panel analysis that examines the impact on completed fertility for specific cohorts. Using aggregate vital statistics (1991–2019) and the synthetic control method, the period analysis indicates a long‐run increase in period fertility, which may reflect both shifts in the timing of childbearing and changes in completed fertility among affected cohorts. To assess completed fertility, we conduct panel analysis using a 20% sample of Canadian tax returns and a dynamic difference‐in‐differences approach. For two relatively older cohorts of women who already entered reproductive years before the reform, we find that the policy reduced completed fertility while increasing their labour supply. Taken together, the findings show that the policy raised period fertility but lowered completed fertility for certain cohorts, indicating that its effects depend on the life‐cycle stage at which women were exposed.
abstract_zh: 我们采用两种互补方法研究1997年魁北克家庭政策的生育效应：（i）基于时期的重复横截面分析，考察其对时期生育率（即特定日历年的生育率，如每千名15至49岁女性的出生人数）的影响；（ii）基于队列的面板分析，考察其对特定队列完成生育率的影响。利用汇总生命统计数据（1991-2019年）和合成控制法，时期分析表明时期生育率出现长期上升，这可能既反映了生育时间安排的转变，也反映了受影响队列完成生育率的变化。为评估完成生育率，我们使用加拿大税务申报表的20%样本和动态双重差分法进行面板分析。对于改革前已进入育龄期的两个相对较年长的女性队列，我们发现该政策降低了其完成生育率，同时增加了其劳动供给。综合来看，研究结果表明该政策提高了时期生育率，但降低了特定队列的完成生育率，表明其效应取决于女性暴露于政策时所处的生命周期阶段。

title: Monetary Policy in Mandarin Capitalism
title_zh: 普通话资本主义下的货币政策
title_primary: 普通话资本主义下的货币政策
title_secondary: Monetary Policy in Mandarin Capitalism
authors: Jeffery (Jinfan) Chang, Wei Xiong
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper investigates why China’s recurrent credit expansions have coincided with persistently weak inflation. We argue that this pattern reflects the country’s production-oriented monetary regime. At the aggregate level, faster monetary-financial expansion temporarily raises PPI inflation but depresses it over longer horizons. At the sectoral level, liability growth among listed industrial firms is followed by weaker producer prices, lower profitability, higher leverage, rising inventories, and reduced capacity utilization. We also find asymmetric supply-chain transmission: downstream liability growth raises upstream PPI inflation, while upstream liability growth does not generate a corresponding downstream price response. These findings indicate that credit expansion in China tends to sustain production and balance sheets rather than stimulate final demand. As a result, monetary policy operates less as a conventional tool for demand management and durable reflation, and more as a mechanism for preserving production capacity and supporting growth.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了中国周期性信贷扩张为何与持续疲弱的通胀并存。我们认为，这一现象反映了该国以生产为导向的货币体制。在总体层面，更快的货币金融扩张短期内推高生产者价格指数（PPI）通胀，但在更长时期内则抑制之。在行业层面，上市工业企业负债增长后，伴随生产者价格走弱、盈利能力下降、杠杆率上升、库存增加及产能利用率降低。我们还发现不对称的供应链传导效应：下游负债增长推升上游PPI通胀，而上游负债增长并未引发相应的下游价格反应。这些发现表明，中国的信贷扩张倾向于维持生产和资产负债表，而非刺激最终需求。因此，货币政策更多作为保全生产能力和支持增长的一种机制，而非传统的需求管理和持久再通胀工具。

title: Long-term impact of 3-D urban expansion on the thermal environment in the Yangtze River Delta region, China
title_zh: 长三角地区三维城市扩张对热环境的长期影响
title_primary: 长三角地区三维城市扩张对热环境的长期影响
title_secondary: Long-term impact of 3-D urban expansion on the thermal environment in the Yangtze River Delta region, China
authors: Chenglong Yin, Ruishan Chen, Xiangming Xiao, Yi Yin, Tim Van de Voorde 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Rapid urbanization is reshaping landscapes worldwide, concentrating populations and economic activities while intensifying environmental challenges. Understanding the long-term impacts of three-dimensional (3-D) urban expansion on the thermal environment is essential for advancing the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals and mitigating climate change. While the urban heat island (UHI) effect has been extensively studied, most research has overlooked how regional-scale long-term thermal dynamics evolve under sustained 3-D urban expansion. Previous studies have largely focused on single or several cities in short time periods, leaving the long-term regional consequences of 3-D expansion poorly understood. Here, we examined the Yangtze River Delta (YRD) region from 2000 to 2020 to assess how long-term 3-D (horizontal and vertical) urban expansion shapes land surface temperature (LST) and surface urban heat island intensity (SUHII). During this period, impervious surface area (ISA) increased from 16493.90 km² to 51738.24 km², while mean building height (BH) showed a slight overall increase, indicating the coexistence of rapid horizontal expansion and moderate vertical urban growth. Both annual mean LST and SUHII show a fluctuating but overall upward trend during daytime and nighttime. In a 3-D context, LST and SUHII were positively correlated with impervious surface coverage (ISC) and BH. Notably, when the horizontal urban intensity gradient was in the range of 0–0.4, the value of LST was relatively low. The increase in SUHII along the horizontal urban intensity gradient at nighttime was smaller than at daytime, and there was an obvious inflection point (ISC = 0.8). In addition, when the vertical urban intensity gradient ranged from 20 to 30 m, it had the most unfavorable impact on the thermal environment of the YRD region. These findings provide novel insights into the long-term thermal impacts of 3-D urban expansion. They highlight critical thresholds of urban form that exacerbate heat stress, offering valuable implications for formulating effective urban heat adaptation policies in rapidly urbanizing regions.
abstract_zh: 快速城市化正在重塑全球景观，集中人口和经济活动，同时加剧环境挑战。理解三维（3-D）城市扩张对热环境的长期影响，对于推进联合国可持续发展目标和减缓气候变化至关重要。尽管城市热岛（UHI）效应已被广泛研究，但大多数研究忽视了在持续的三维城市扩张下，区域尺度的长期热动态如何演变。以往研究多聚焦于单个或少数城市在短时间内的变化，导致对三维扩张的长期区域后果认识不足。本研究以2000年至2020年的长江三角洲（YRD）地区为例，评估长期三维（水平和垂直）城市扩张如何塑造地表温度（LST）和地表城市热岛强度（SUHII）。在此期间，不透水表面面积（ISA）从16493.90平方公里增加到51738.24平方公里，而平均建筑高度（BH）总体略有上升，表明快速水平扩张与适度垂直城市增长并存。年际平均LST和SUHII在白天和夜间均呈现波动但总体上升的趋势。在三维背景下，LST和SUHII与不透水表面覆盖率（ISC）和BH呈正相关。值得注意的是，当水平城市强度梯度在0–0.4范围内时，LST值相对较低。夜间沿水平城市强度梯度的SUHII增幅小于白天，并存在明显的拐点（ISC = 0.8）。此外，当垂直城市强度梯度在20至30米范围内时，对长三角地区热环境的不利影响最为显著。这些发现为三维城市扩张的长期热影响提供了新颖见解，揭示了加剧热应激的城市形态关键阈值，为快速城市化地区制定有效的城市热适应政策提供了宝贵启示。

abstract_zh: 文书之困：信息与申请协助对印度社会福利申领的影响 作者：Sarika Gupta 发表于《美国经济期刊：经济政策》2026年8月第18卷第3期，第342-371页 摘要：全球各国政府通过行政程序管理社会项目，旨在为符合条件的公民提供福利。然而，繁琐的文书工作往往成为申领障碍。本文利用印度一项大规模社会福利项目的随机实验，评估了信息提供与申请协助对福利申领率的影响。研究发现，仅提供信息对申领率无显著改善，而结合申请协助则显著提升了申领率，尤其对弱势群体效果更为明显。这一结果表明，程序性障碍而非信息缺失是福利申领的主要瓶颈，简化申请流程或提供针对性协助可有效提升社会项目的覆盖效果。

title: Did Recent Inflation Reflect a Nonlinear Phillips Curve?
title_zh: 近期通胀是否反映了非线性的菲利普斯曲线？
title_primary: 近期通胀是否反映了非线性的菲利普斯曲线？
title_secondary: Did Recent Inflation Reflect a Nonlinear Phillips Curve?
authors: Beaudry, Paul, Hou, Chenyu, Portier, Franck
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review: Insights · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: To examine the potential role of a nonlinear Phillips curve in explaining recent US inflation, we combine evidence from both crosscity variation and aggregate time series data. A central challenge relates to how best to control for the potential confounding effect of inflation expectations. The paper explores several options. Our findings place into question the robustness that tight labour markets, due to a nonlinear Phillips curve, played a very important role in the recent inflation episode.
abstract_zh: 为探究非线性菲利普斯曲线在解释近期美国通胀中的潜在作用，我们结合了跨城市差异与总体时间序列数据的证据。核心挑战在于如何最优地控制通胀预期可能产生的混杂效应。本文探讨了多种解决方案。研究结果表明，由于非线性菲利普斯曲线的存在，劳动力市场紧张在近期通胀事件中发挥重要作用的结论缺乏稳健性。

title: Diversion Risk, Markups, and the Financing Cost Advantage of Trade Credit
title_zh: 转移风险、加成率与贸易信贷的融资成本优势
title_primary: 转移风险、加成率与贸易信贷的融资成本优势
title_secondary: Diversion Risk, Markups, and the Financing Cost Advantage of Trade Credit
authors: Garcia-Marin, Alvaro, Justel, Santiago, Schmidt-Eisenlohr, Tim
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Trade credit is a key source of short-term finance. This paper develops a model where trade credit reduces borrowing from banks. This reduction gives rise to a financing cost advantage of trade credit that increases in the product of markups and borrowing costs. Chilean export data confirm this prediction. A one-standard-deviation rise in upstream markups increases trade credit by 9 days. The intensive margin is responsible for about 60 percent of this effect, which strengthens with destination-country borrowing costs. We estimate that trade credit allows U.S. firms to reduce formal borrowing by $1.4 trillion, generating annual savings of $39 billion.
abstract_zh: 贸易信贷是短期融资的关键来源。本文构建了一个模型，其中贸易信贷减少了企业从银行的借款。这种减少使得贸易信贷产生融资成本优势，该优势随加成率与借款成本的乘积递增。智利出口数据证实了这一预测：上游加成率每上升一个标准差，贸易信贷期限将增加9天。集约边际对此效应的贡献约为60%，且该效应随目的地国借款成本的上升而增强。我们估算，贸易信贷使美国企业减少1.4万亿美元的正规借款，每年节省390亿美元。

title: The dictatorial public goods game
title_zh: 独裁公共品博弈
title_primary: 独裁公共品博弈
title_secondary: The dictatorial public goods game
authors: Gabriele Camera, Gary Charness, Nir Chemaya, Ro’i Zultan
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We propose a novel game, the Dictatorial Public Goods Game , to study the interplay between collective resource generation and centralized provision of public goods. After making choices in a standard Voluntary Contribution Mechanism (VCM), one player is selected from the group to administrate the contributions: either provide the public good or expropriate the collected resources for personal gain. We find that adding this centralized mechanism reduces efficiency compared to the standard VCM. Although higher contributions increase the material incentive to expropriate, they lead to more provision. Thus, pro-social choices in the contribution and in the provision stages act as complements, reflecting the generation of social capital in the group. Administrators tend to provide more when the statutory default is expropriation rather than provision. This counter status-quo effect is in line with the standard provision-maintenance gap in the literature, but is not explained by the theoretical arguments typically invoked to explain such framing effects.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新颖的博弈——独裁性公共品博弈，用以研究集体资源生成与公共品集中供给之间的相互作用。在标准自愿贡献机制（VCM）中做出选择后，从群体中选出一名玩家来管理贡献：要么提供公共品，要么将收集的资源据为己有。我们发现，与标准VCM相比，加入这一集中机制会降低效率。尽管更高的贡献增加了侵占的物质激励，但它们反而导致了更多的供给。因此，贡献阶段和供给阶段的亲社会行为互为补充，反映了群体中社会资本的生成。当法定默认设置为侵占而非供给时，管理者倾向于提供更多。这种反现状效应与文献中标准的供给-维护缺口一致，但无法用通常用于解释此类框架效应的理论论点来解释。

title: 轮作补贴能否提高粮食全要素生产率——来自东北三省玉米和大豆种植户的微观证据
title_zh: 轮作补贴能否提高粮食全要素生产率——来自东北三省玉米和大豆种植户的微观证据

authors: 杨新宇, 高鸣
official: 官方发布 2026-06-22 · 来源：CNKI RSS
abstract: 轮作补贴是引导农户参与轮作的经济激励工具,对加强东北地区耕地保护、推动农业可持续发展具有重要作用。基于全国农村固定观察点2019—2023年东北三省农户数据,以玉米-大豆轮作补贴为例,本文系统分析了轮作补贴对玉米、大豆全要素生产率的影响及其作用路径。研究表明:第一,轮作补贴显著提升了玉米和大豆全要素生产率,其中对玉米全要素生产率的促进效应具有一定滞后性;第二,轮作补贴主要通过要素投入和技术采纳两条...

title: Court Capture, Local Protectionism, and Economic Integration: Evidence from China
title_zh: 法院俘获、地方保护主义与经济一体化：来自中国的证据
title_primary: 法院俘获、地方保护主义与经济一体化：来自中国的证据
title_secondary: Court Capture, Local Protectionism, and Economic Integration: Evidence from China
authors: Ernest Liu, Yi Lu, Wenwei Peng, Shaoda Wang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Court capture in developing countries is pervasive, yet its economic effects remain underexplored. We study a Chinese reform that transferred financial and personnel authority over local courts from local to provincial governments. Exploiting the staggered roll-out, we find a 7.3% decline in local defendants’ win rates against non-local plaintiffs, alongside improved judicial quality. The reform encouraged smaller non-local firms to litigate and attracted non-local investment, potentially raising GDP by 1.9%. Yet favoritism toward politically connected firms and inter-provincial protectionism remain, and centralization itself promotes less qualified judges— revealing both its promise and limits.
abstract_zh: 发展中国家普遍存在法院被地方俘获的现象，但其经济影响尚未得到充分研究。本文研究了中国将地方法院的财政与人事管理权从地方政府转移至省级政府的改革。利用该改革分阶段推行的特征，我们发现本地被告对非本地原告的胜诉率下降7.3%，同时司法质量得到提升。改革鼓励小型非本地企业提起诉讼并吸引非本地投资，可能使GDP增长1.9%。然而，对政治关联企业的偏袒及省际保护主义依然存在，且集权化本身导致法官资质下降——这揭示了改革的成效与局限。

title: Do Producer organizations Promote Climate-Smart Agriculture? assessing direct and spillover effects in Nigeria
title_zh: 生产者组织是否促进了气候智慧型农业？评估尼日利亚的直接效应与溢出效应
title_primary: 生产者组织是否促进了气候智慧型农业？评估尼日利亚的直接效应与溢出效应
title_secondary: Do Producer organizations Promote Climate-Smart Agriculture? assessing direct and spillover effects in Nigeria
authors: Abebayehu Girma Geffersa, Martin Paul Jr. Tabe-Ojong
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Climate change threatens the livelihoods of millions of smallholder farmers in sub-Saharan Africa and beyond, yet the adoption of Climate-Smart Agriculture (CSA) remains low. In this paper, we examine the role of producer organizations (POs) in promoting CSA adoption among their members and non-members through spillover effects. We rely on a three-wave panel dataset of over 1,500 farm households fielded between 2017 and 2019 and estimated the multivariate probit model to capture interdependencies in adopting four key CSA practices: climate-resilient groundnut varieties (CRVs), organic fertilizers, crop rotation, and intercropping. We also examine the association between POs and the adoption intensity of CSA practices, including number of CSA practices used and area under CRVs. Employing the Mundlak–Chamberlain device to address time-invariant unobserved heterogeneity, we find that PO membership is positively associated with the adoption of CSA practices. Beyond the independent use of these CSA practices, we also highlight a positive association between POs and both the adoption intensity and the joint use of these practices which indicates bundling. Importantly, positive spillover effects are observed among non-members, especially for low-cost, easily observable practices such as intercropping and crop rotation, indicating the role of peer learning and informal networks. Conversely, spillovers are less evident for input-intensive practices such as CRVs and organic fertilizers, highlighting the need for targeted support. The results point to two distinct adaptation pathways: a technology-driven strategy reliant on financial and institutional resources, and a diversification-driven strategy based on cost-effective, observable practices. Overall, the study demonstrates the critical role of POs in fostering resilient and sustainable agricultural systems through both direct engagement and community-wide spillovers.
abstract_zh: 气候变化威胁着撒哈拉以南非洲及其他地区数百万小农户的生计，然而气候智能型农业（CSA）的采用率仍然较低。本文考察了生产者组织（POs）在通过溢出效应促进其成员及非成员采用CSA方面的作用。我们利用2017年至2019年间收集的超过1500户农户的三轮面板数据，并估计多元概率比模型以捕捉采用四种关键CSA实践之间的相互依赖性：气候适应性花生品种（CRVs）、有机肥料、作物轮作和间作。我们还考察了生产者组织与CSA实践采用强度之间的关联，包括采用的CSA实践数量及CRVs种植面积。采用Mundlak–Chamberlain方法处理时间不变的非观测异质性，我们发现生产者组织成员身份与CSA实践的采用呈正相关。除了这些CSA实践的独立使用外，我们还强调了生产者组织与采用强度及这些实践联合使用之间的正相关关系，这表明存在捆绑效应。重要的是，在非成员中观察到正向溢出效应，尤其是对于成本低、易于观察的实践，如间作和作物轮作，这表明了同伴学习和非正式网络的作用。相反，对于投入密集型实践，如CRVs和有机肥料，溢出效应不太明显，凸显了定向支持的必要性。研究结果指出了两条不同的适应路径：一条依赖金融和制度资源的技术驱动策略，另一条基于成本效益高、可观察实践的多样化驱动策略。总体而言，该研究证明了生产者组织在通过直接参与和社区范围的溢出效应促进韧性和可持续农业系统方面的关键作用。

title: Communicating Scientific Uncertainty via Approximate Posteriors
title_zh: 通过近似后验分布传达科学不确定性
title_primary: 通过近似后验分布传达科学不确定性
title_secondary: Communicating Scientific Uncertainty via Approximate Posteriors
authors: Isaiah Andrews, Jesse M. Shapiro
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We cast the problem of communicating scientific uncertainty as one of reporting a posterior distribution on an unknown parameter to an audience of Bayesian decision‐makers. We establish novel bounds on the audience's regret when the analyst reports an approximation to a posterior that the audience treats as exact. Under a palatable restriction on the audience's decision problems, the bounds take an especially convenient form. Under a further restriction on the audience's priors, a bootstrap distribution can be used as a stand‐in posterior. We propose a practical recipe for checking whether a conventional statistical report (say, a normal parameterized by a point estimate and standard error) is a good approximation, and for improving the report if it is not. We illustrate our proposals using the articles in the 2021 American Economic Review that use a bootstrap for inference.
abstract_zh: 我们将科学不确定性沟通问题视为向贝叶斯决策者受众报告未知参数后验分布的过程。我们为当分析师报告一个受众视为精确的后验近似值时，受众的遗憾建立了新的界限。在对受众决策问题施加一个可接受的限制条件下，这些界限呈现出特别便捷的形式。进一步限制受众的先验分布时，自助法分布可作为后验的替代。我们提出了一种实用方法，用于检查常规统计报告（例如，由点估计和标准误参数化的正态分布）是否构成良好近似，并在非近似时改进报告。我们利用2021年《美国经济评论》中使用自助法进行推断的文章来阐述我们的建议。

title: Multivariate Trend Inflation in the United States and the Euro Area
title_zh: 美国和欧元区的多元趋势通胀
title_primary: 美国和欧元区的多元趋势通胀
title_secondary: Multivariate Trend Inflation in the United States and the Euro Area
authors: Max‐Sebastian Dovì
official: 官方在线 2026-06-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: I provide a precision‐sampler‐based replication of the multivariate unobserved component stochastic volatility outlier‐adjusted model of Stock and Watson (2016) applied to inflation in the United States and the Euro Area (EA). I find a substantial post‐2020 increase in trend inflation for both the United States and the EA, and estimate end‐2024 trend inflation at 2.3 and 2.0 percent, respectively.
abstract_zh: 本文基于Stock与Watson（2016）提出的多变量不可观测成分随机波动异常值调整模型，采用精确采样器方法进行复制，并将其应用于美国和欧元区的通胀分析。研究发现，2020年后美国和欧元区的趋势通胀均出现显著上升，预计2024年底的趋势通胀率分别为2.3%和2.0%。

title: Which experiments test a model?
title_zh: 哪些实验检验了一个模型？
title_primary: 哪些实验检验了一个模型？
title_secondary: Which experiments test a model?
authors: Paul J. Healy, Greg Leo
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Given a model of preferences, what choice data or experiment is sufficient to definitively test whether a subject is consistent with the model or to classify them into some “type” within the model? We characterize all experiments that test or classify a given model using a novel graph-theoretic construction: the labeled permutohedron. We show how these results can be used to identify the smallest experiments that achieve a particular goal.
abstract_zh: 给定偏好模型，何种选择数据或实验足以明确检验受试者是否与模型一致，或将其归类为模型内的某种“类型”？我们通过一种新颖的图论构造——标记置换多面体——刻画了所有检验或分类给定模型的实验。我们展示了这些结果如何用于识别实现特定目标的最小实验。

title: Common Agent or Double Agent? Pharmacy Benefit Managers in the Prescription Drug Market
title_zh: 共同代理人还是双重代理人？处方药市场中的药品福利管理者
title_primary: 共同代理人还是双重代理人？处方药市场中的药品福利管理者
title_secondary: Common Agent or Double Agent? Pharmacy Benefit Managers in the Prescription Drug Market
authors: Rena M. Conti, Brigham Frandsen, Michael Powell, James B. Rebitzer
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Pharmacy benefit managers dominate the U.S. pharmaceutical market but are controversial and poorly understood. We analyze PBMs as market intermediaries that operate formulary contests in which on-patent brand-drug makers compete for favorable placement by offering rebates off list price. These formulary contests deliver efficiency gains compared to drug makers selling directly to consumers; PBMs capture some of these gains. Our approach answers key questions regarding the determinants of efficiency, rebates, list prices, and PBM market power in the pharmaceutical market. Our analysis also explains how common contracting practices, federal regulations, and incentives within formulary contests can undermine market efficiency.
abstract_zh: 药品福利管理公司主导着美国药品市场，但颇具争议且认知度较低。我们将PBM视为市场中介机构，其运作处方集竞争机制——专利品牌药制造商通过提供标价折扣来争夺有利的处方集地位。相较于药企直接面向消费者销售的模式，这种处方集竞争机制能带来效率提升；PBM则从中获取部分收益。我们的分析框架解答了关于药品市场效率决定因素、折扣机制、标价形成及PBM市场势力的关键问题。研究同时揭示了处方集竞争中的常见合同实践、联邦监管规定及激励机制如何可能削弱市场效率。

title: Training as a club good: Merchant apprenticeship in sixteenth‐century Europe
title_zh: 培训作为俱乐部产品：16世纪欧洲的商人学徒制
title_primary: 培训作为俱乐部产品：16世纪欧洲的商人学徒制
title_secondary: Training as a club good: Merchant apprenticeship in sixteenth‐century Europe
authors: Esther Sahle
official: 官方在线 2026-02-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Based on the extensive correspondence of the sixteenth‐century merchant firm of Tucher, this article casts pre‐modern mercantile training in a new light. Rather than training for seven or more years with one master, including a possible sojourn abroad, apprentices served a string of short‐term contracts with masters across different European countries. This form of organization raised the cost of training significantly. I argue that participants bore these costs because apprenticeship served a purpose beyond the transmission of skills. The network‐based nature of trade meant that firms could expect to retain their investment in training through future business ties with the former apprentice. Over the course of the apprenticeship, reputation mechanisms served to vet the apprentice's suitability as a future trading partner. Under these circumstances, training became a club good. It facilitated network expansion and contributed to solving the fundamental problem of exchange.
abstract_zh: 基于十六世纪商人企业图赫尔家族的大量往来信函，本文重新审视了前现代商业培训。与单一师傅进行七年或更长时间的学徒训练（可能包括海外居留）不同，学徒们在不同欧洲国家的师傅之间签订一系列短期合同。这种组织形式显著提高了培训成本。我认为，参与者之所以承担这些成本，是因为学徒制除了技能传授之外，还服务于其他目的。贸易的网络性质意味着，企业可以通过与前学徒未来的商业联系，期望保留其培训投资。在学徒期间，声誉机制用于考察学徒作为未来贸易伙伴的适宜性。在此情况下，培训成为一种俱乐部产品，促进了网络扩展，并有助于解决交换的根本问题。

title: Climate Change Adaptation, Climatic Hazards and Agricultural Feminisation: Empirical Evidence From the Cambodian Agricultural Survey 2019–2021
title_zh: 气候变化适应、气候危害与农业女性化：基于2019-2021年柬埔寨农业调查的实证证据
title_primary: 气候变化适应、气候危害与农业女性化：基于2019-2021年柬埔寨农业调查的实证证据
title_secondary: Climate Change Adaptation, Climatic Hazards and Agricultural Feminisation: Empirical Evidence From the Cambodian Agricultural Survey 2019–2021
authors: Sonia Akter, Linh Bui
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2025-10-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: ABSTRACT Climate change is causing more frequent and intense climatic hazards worldwide, disrupting agricultural systems by altering temperature and precipitation patterns, as well as extreme weather events, which in turn are reshaping gender roles in rural economies. While the feminisation of agriculture—where women assume greater agricultural responsibilities as men transition to non‐farm work—has been widely observed, less is known about whether this trend also extends to women's involvement in farm‐level decision‐making. This study examines the relationship between climate change adaptation, climatic hazards and the multidimensional feminisation of agriculture in Cambodia. Using three waves of nationally representative data from the Cambodia Agriculture Survey (2019–2021), we analyse women's expanding roles as both unpaid family labourers and hired workers as well as their growing influence in farm management as decision‐makers. Our findings show a significant increase in women's involvement in agriculture in Cambodia both as labourers and decision‐makers. Crop and livelihood diversification are key factors driving this change. All forms of agricultural feminisation are more pronounced in households affected by climate hazards. This suggests a significant correlation between climate change adaptation, environmental stress and the growing feminisation of agriculture in Cambodia.
abstract_zh: 摘要 气候变化正导致全球范围内气候灾害更加频繁和剧烈，通过改变温度和降水模式以及极端天气事件，扰乱农业系统，进而重塑农村经济中的性别角色。尽管农业女性化——即随着男性转向非农工作，女性承担更多农业责任——已被广泛观察到，但关于这一趋势是否也延伸至女性在农场层面决策中的参与，所知甚少。本研究考察了气候变化适应、气候灾害与柬埔寨农业多维女性化之间的关系。利用柬埔寨农业调查（2019—2021年）三轮全国代表性数据，我们分析了女性作为无酬家庭劳动者和雇佣工人角色的扩展，以及她们作为决策者在农场管理中日益增长的影响力。我们的研究结果显示，柬埔寨女性在农业中的参与显著增加，无论是作为劳动者还是决策者。作物和生计多样化是推动这一变化的关键因素。所有形式的农业女性化在受气候灾害影响的家庭中更为显著。这表明气候变化适应、环境压力与柬埔寨农业日益女性化之间存在显著相关性。

title: Monetary policy transmission in India – a coefficient-restricted VAR approach
title_zh: 印度货币政策传导——系数受限VAR方法
title_primary: 印度货币政策传导——系数受限VAR方法
title_secondary: Monetary policy transmission in India – a coefficient-restricted VAR approach
authors: Joyal P. Joseph, Santosh Kumar Dash
official: 官方在线 2025-09-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The empirical literature on monetary policy transmission to output and inflation remains inconclusive, with varying results stemming from differences in the choice of policy variables and methodologies. This study uses a coefficient-restricted vector Autoregression (RVAR) model, relatively less explored in the Indian context, to analyse the monetary policy transmission to output and inflation via interest, credit, and exchange rate channels. RVAR provides a relatively effective transmission channel by restricting the impact of parallel channels without assuming any contemporaneous relations. The impulse responses using the quarterly data from 2001–02 Q1 to 2021–22 Q2 reveal that a one-unit shock in the Weighted Average Call Money rate (WACMR) leads to a 0.77% and 0.15% fall in growth and inflation, respectively, through interest channel, while the respective fall is 0.78% and 0.20% via credit channel. The study also finds that the exchange rate channel has the opposite effect, with the credit channel being stronger than the interest rate channel, contrary to majority of the existing literature. KEYWORDS: Monetary policy RBI inflation VAR coefficient-restricted VAR JEL CLASSIFICATION: E52 E58 E31 C32 Acknowledgements This paper has greatly benefited from the insightful comments of the editor and reviewers, to whom we extend our sincere gratitude. We also express our heartfelt thanks to Dr. Kiran Kumar Kakarlapudi for his unwavering guidance and support throughout the study. We would also like to acknowledge Prof. KJ Joseph and Dr. Anoop S Kumar for their helpful feedback during the course of this research. Any remaining errors are our own.
abstract_zh: 关于货币政策传导至产出与通胀的实证研究仍无定论，不同研究因政策变量选择和方法论差异而结论各异。本研究采用在印度语境中较少探索的系数约束向量自回归（RVAR）模型，通过利率、信贷和汇率渠道分析货币政策对产出与通胀的传导效应。RVAR模型通过限制平行渠道的冲击影响，且无需假设同期关系，从而提供相对有效的传导渠道分析。基于2001-02财年第一季度至2021-22财年第二季度的季度数据脉冲响应分析显示：加权平均隔夜拆借利率（WACMR）一个单位冲击通过利率渠道导致增长率和通胀率分别下降0.77%和0.15%，而通过信贷渠道的相应降幅则为0.78%和0.20%。研究同时发现汇率渠道呈现反向效应，且信贷渠道强于利率渠道，这与现有文献的主流结论相悖。 关键词：货币政策 印度储备银行 通胀 VAR 系数约束VAR JEL分类：E52 E58 E31 C32 致谢：本文得益于编辑与审稿人的真知灼见，谨致诚挚谢意。我们衷心感谢Kiran Kumar Kakarlapudi博士在整个研究过程中给予的坚定指导与支持。同时感谢KJ Joseph教授与Anoop S Kumar博士在研究期间提供的宝贵反馈。文责自负。
